selection_rule: baseline non-<tool_call> top-1, tool probability cutoff, one prefix per trace, depth-stratified round robin

next_causal_intervention.token_position: final prompt token / first generated-token decision
next_causal_intervention.induction_operation: add +alpha*mean_diff; +mean_diff is the paper's tool-call direction
next_causal_intervention.negative_control: norm-matched random direction at matching amplitudes
